Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.query

package org.aristonis.diwan.database.query
The query builder: build reads and writes fluently and compile them to SQL for one database.

Start from a QueryFactory, which ties a connection to the QueryGrammar and Processor of its database. Each database module supplies its own grammar and processor; the core never depends on one and holds only the base grammar, which writes Laravel's generic SQL.

This package holds the builder, its clause records and the base grammar; raw SQL is an Expression from the root package. It does not hold database-specific SQL, schema building, or a row type: rows are plain maps, as Connection returns them.
